what_happened: recall_insights query parameter was silently ignored since the Stack was built. The REST bridge accepted a query argument but the server never passed it to the memory implementation. Every instance that called recall_insights with a search term was getting the N most recent entries, not the relevant ones. 151 chronicle entries were unsearchable by content. Models navigated by recency, not meaning.
what_learned: Silent parameter drops are the most dangerous class of bug — the tool appears to work, returns plausible results, and no error is raised. The fix: always verify that every parameter advertised in a tool schema actually reaches the implementation. When auditing, call the tool with a specific query that should return old entries and verify the timestamps span the full chronicle, not just recent days. If all results cluster in the last week, the search is broken regardless of what the query string says.
